title: CropType
description: Agricultural crop types for the GAP (Southeastern Anatolia Project) region. 8-crop set; HAZELNUT removed in v2.0.0 (not grown in GAP); RICE (Çeltik) added in v2.1.0 (active GAP crop, KR-092 seasonal flight calendar scope); MAIZE renamed to CORN in v3.0.0 (MAJOR/breaking — aligns the contract canonical value with the platform CropType VO and the worker CropType enum, both of which already use CORN); RED_LENTIL removed in v4.0.0 (MAJOR/breaking — mirrors the worker dropping LENTIL from its crop vocabulary).

metadata.changeNote: MAJOR (breaking): crop type RED_LENTIL removed. Rationale: the worker is dropping LENTIL (Mercimek) from its crop vocabulary; the platform mirrors that removal to keep the contract 100% synced with the worker (no latent divergence). RED_LENTIL was the GAP-canonical spelling bridged to the worker/platform LENTIL via metadata.aliases; that RED_LENTIL<->LENTIL cross-repo alias is now retired; RED_LENTIL is fully removed with no metadata.archived entry retained (removal provenance kept in this changeNote + migration guide docs/migration_guides/crop_type_red_lentil_removal.md). Requires migration guide: docs/migration_guides/crop_type_red_lentil_removal.md. After removal the GAP set is 8 crops (COTTON, PISTACHIO, CORN, WHEAT, SUNFLOWER, GRAPE, OLIVE, RICE). Prior v3.0.0 (MAJOR/breaking): MAIZE renamed to CORN (metadata.aliases: CORN->MAIZE; migration: docs/migration_guides/crop_type_maize_to_corn.md). Prior v2.1.0 (MINOR): +RICE. Prior v2.0.0 (MAJOR/breaking): -HAZELNUT (Black Sea crop, not grown in GAP; migration: docs/migration_guides/crop_type_hazelnut_removal.md). Note: phenology_stage.enum.v1.json MAIZE_* stage codes remain unchanged (distinct enum).

gapPriorities.description: GAP region priority crops (ALL 8 crops are GAP priorities - these are the ONLY supported crops)

aliases.description: Cross-repo / legacy name mapping. TarlaAnaliz (GAP) canonical value -> alternative/legacy names. Used only for interop translation, NOT as accepted enum values. CORN->MAIZE is a legacy alias (MAIZE was the canonical value before v3.0.0).

notes.breaking_change_policy: Adding new crop types is non-breaking (MINOR). Removing or renaming crop types is breaking (MAJOR) and requires migration guide.
notes.gap_region: GAP (Güneydoğu Anadolu Projesi) region includes: Adıyaman, Batman, Diyarbakır, Gaziantep, Kilis, Mardin, Siirt, Şanlıurfa, Şırnak
notes.usage: This enum is used across schemas (Field, Mission, Pricing) and UI components. Always reference this canonical source.
notes.worker_alignment: As of v3.0.0 the contract, platform and worker all use CORN as the canonical maize value (MAIZE is a legacy alias only, kept for reading old payloads). As of v4.0.0 RED_LENTIL is removed (the worker dropped LENTIL (Mercimek) from its crop vocabulary); the RED_LENTIL<->LENTIL cross-repo alias is retired. RICE (Çeltik) is an active GAP crop within the KR-092 seasonal flight calendar scope, though the worker Stage-2 model remains blocked_by_data (KR-018 hard-gate). This GAP set is NOT 1:1 with the sibling/worker CropType, which additionally carries Aegean crops (CHERRY/FIG/APPLE/PEACH) not present here.
